written_rules: During the base game, 1-5 HARD HAT, HORIZONTAL SAW HARD HAT, VERTICAL SAW HARD HAT and/or SUPER SAW HARD HAT symbols may be placed on active rows.
HORIZONTAL SAW HARD HAT, VERTICAL SAW HARD HAT symbols do not appear on reel 4 during the base game, except via placement.
SUPER SAW HARD HAT symbol only appears via placement.
